question: Lai Haraoba is the earliest form of which of the following classical dances of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manipuri.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lai Haraoba** is a traditional festival of **Manipur,** which is celebrated through **dance and music** performances.
 
• It is believed that Lai Haraoba gave birth to **Manipuri classical dance,** which is now recognized as one of the** eight classical dance** forms of India. 
 
• Lai Haraoba is the **earliest form of Manipuri **classical dance of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Manipuri** is a classical dance form that originated in the **northeastern state of Manipur.**
 
• It is characterized by **graceful movements, **delicate **hand gestures, **and **fluid footwork.**
 
• **Mohiniyattam **is a classical dance form from **Kerala,** which is also known for its graceful movements and facial expressions.
 
• **Sattriya **is a classical dance form from **Assam,** which is known for its religious themes and vibrant costumes.
 
• **Kathakali** is a classical dance form from** Kerala, **which is known for its elaborate makeup, costumes, and facial expressions.
